api/src/routers/maintenance.py.name: Workspace upkeep
api/src/routers/maintenance.py.description: Holds the settings and clean-up runs that decide how long the platform keeps old records, files and activity history.

api/src/routers/mcp_connections.py.name: AI service links
api/src/routers/mcp_connections.py.description: Lets each client connect Claude and other AI assistants to outside services, and choose which tools each one may use.

api/src/routers/mcp_oauth_callback.py.name: Service sign-in return
api/src/routers/mcp_oauth_callback.py.description: Welcomes people back from an outside service after they approve access, then stores the connection.

api/src/routers/mcp_servers.py.name: AI service catalog
api/src/routers/mcp_servers.py.description: Keeps the list of outside services AI assistants can be connected to, with how each one signs people in.

api/src/routers/mcp.py.name: AI assistant gateway
api/src/routers/mcp.py.description: Serves and controls the connection that lets AI assistants look things up and run approved tools in the platform.

api/src/routers/memory.py.name: Assistant memory
api/src/routers/memory.py.description: Stores and searches the notes AI assistants keep between conversations, with settings for each person and the whole platform.

api/src/routers/metrics.py.name: Dashboard figures
api/src/routers/metrics.py.description: Works out the activity, cost and resource numbers shown on the dashboard and its charts.

api/src/routers/mfa.py.name: Two-step sign-in
api/src/routers/mfa.py.description: Sets up and manages the extra security code asked for at sign-in, including recovery codes and remembered devices.

api/src/routers/model_catalog.py.name: Model names
api/src/routers/model_catalog.py.description: Turns raw model codes into readable names wherever run history, usage and settings show them.

api/src/routers/notifications.py.name: In-app notices
api/src/routers/notifications.py.description: Lists and clears the messages shown to a person in the app, and lets an administrator release a stuck upload.

api/src/routers/oauth_config.py.name: Company sign-in settings
api/src/routers/oauth_config.py.description: Sets up Microsoft, Google or another company sign-in for the platform and tests that each one answers correctly.

api/src/routers/oauth_connections.py.name: Workflow sign-ins
api/src/routers/oauth_connections.py.description: Keeps the sign-ins workflows use to reach outside services, renewing them before they expire.

GET /api/maintenance/app-sdk-upgrades/se.name: App update settings
GET /api/maintenance/app-sdk-upgrades/se.description: Shows whether published apps may be refreshed automatically onto newer building blocks.

PUT /api/maintenance/app-sdk-upgrades/se.name: Change app update settings
PUT /api/maintenance/app-sdk-upgrades/se.description: Sets whether published apps are refreshed automatically and how quickly a rollout moves.

GET /api/maintenance/artifact-retention/.name: File retention settings
GET /api/maintenance/artifact-retention/.description: Shows how long generated files and run attachments are kept before clean-up deletes them.

PUT /api/maintenance/artifact-retention/.name: Change file retention
PUT /api/maintenance/artifact-retention/.description: Sets how long generated files and run attachments are kept before clean-up deletes them.

POST /api/maintenance/artifact-retention.name: Clean up old files
POST /api/maintenance/artifact-retention.description: Deletes stored files past their retention window, freeing space.

GET /api/maintenance/audit-retention/set.name: Activity retention settings
GET /api/maintenance/audit-retention/set.description: Shows how long the record of who changed what is kept before being archived.

PUT /api/maintenance/audit-retention/set.name: Change activity retention
PUT /api/maintenance/audit-retention/set.description: Sets how long the record of who changed what is kept before being archived or deleted.

POST /api/maintenance/audit-retention/ru.name: Archive old activity
POST /api/maintenance/audit-retention/ru.description: Starts a background run that archives activity records past their retention window.

GET /api/maintenance/audit-retention/pre.name: Preview activity archiving
GET /api/maintenance/audit-retention/pre.description: Estimates how many activity records the current retention setting would archive.

GET /api/maintenance/authz/legacy-status.name: Old access leftovers
GET /api/maintenance/authz/legacy-status.description: Reports whether anything from the older permission system still needs attention.

GET /api/maintenance/run-retention/setti.name: Run retention settings
GET /api/maintenance/run-retention/setti.description: Shows how long finished run histories are kept before being removed.

PUT /api/maintenance/run-retention/setti.name: Change run retention
PUT /api/maintenance/run-retention/setti.description: Sets how long finished run histories are kept before being removed.

POST /api/maintenance/run-retention/run.name: Remove old runs
POST /api/maintenance/run-retention/run.description: Starts a background clean-up that removes run histories older than the retention window.

GET /api/maintenance/run-retention/previ.name: Preview run removal
GET /api/maintenance/run-retention/previ.description: Estimates how many run histories the current retention window would remove.

GET /api/maintenance/status.name: Workspace health
GET /api/maintenance/status.description: Reports how the workspace is doing: what is set up, what is behind and what needs attention.

POST /api/maintenance/index-docs.name: Index the help pages
POST /api/maintenance/index-docs.description: Rebuilds the searchable copy of platform help so AI assistants can answer questions about Bifrost.

POST /api/maintenance/reimport.name: Reload from source files
POST /api/maintenance/reimport.description: Rebuilds all saved automations, forms and apps from the stored source files.

POST /api/maintenance/cleanup-orphaned.name: Retire missing automations
POST /api/maintenance/cleanup-orphaned.description: Switches off automations whose source file no longer exists so they stop being offered.

POST /api/maintenance/scan-app-dependenc.name: Scan app dependencies
POST /api/maintenance/scan-app-dependenc.description: Reads published app code to record which shared building blocks each app relies on.

POST /api/maintenance/preflight.name: Check before publishing
POST /api/maintenance/preflight.description: Runs the pre-publish checks on the current workspace and reports anything that would break.

GET /api/mcp-connections.name: Connected AI services
GET /api/mcp-connections.description: Lists each client's links to outside services that AI assistants can use.

POST /api/mcp-connections.name: Connect an AI service
POST /api/mcp-connections.description: Links an outside service for a client so assistants can use its tools.

GET /api/mcp-connections/{connection_id}.name: Connection details
GET /api/mcp-connections/{connection_id}.description: Shows one AI service connection's settings and the tools it offers.

PATCH /api/mcp-connections/{connection_i.name: Update a connection
PATCH /api/mcp-connections/{connection_i.description: Changes an AI service connection's settings, replacing its password when a new one is given.

DELETE /api/mcp-connections/{connection_.name: Remove a connection
DELETE /api/mcp-connections/{connection_.description: Deletes an AI service connection along with everything stored for it.

PATCH /api/mcp-connections/{connection_i.name: Allow or block a tool
PATCH /api/mcp-connections/{connection_i.description: Turns one tool on or off for a connection without removing the whole service.

POST /api/mcp-connections/{connection_id.name: Refresh available tools
POST /api/mcp-connections/{connection_id.description: Re-reads the service's tool list so newly added tools can be switched on.

POST /api/mcp-connections/{connection_id.name: Sign in to a service
POST /api/mcp-connections/{connection_id.description: Starts the sign-in trip to an outside service, or connects directly when the service allows it.

GET /api/me/mcp-connections/{connection_.name: Finish service sign-in
GET /api/me/mcp-connections/{connection_.description: Completes the sign-in trip and saves the personal connection for the signed-in person.

GET /api/me/mcp-connections.name: My connected services
GET /api/me/mcp-connections.description: Lists the outside services the signed-in person has connected for their own use.

DELETE /api/me/mcp-connections/{connecti.name: Disconnect my service
DELETE /api/me/mcp-connections/{connecti.description: Removes the signed-in person's own link to an outside service.

GET /api/mcp/oauth/callback.name: Service sign-in return
GET /api/mcp/oauth/callback.description: Receives people back from an outside service after they approve or refuse access, then saves the result.

GET /api/mcp-servers.name: AI services available
GET /api/mcp-servers.description: Lists the outside services that AI assistants can be connected to.

GET /api/mcp-servers/{server_id}.name: Service template details
GET /api/mcp-servers/{server_id}.description: Shows one service template, its connections and the tools it offers.

POST /api/mcp-servers.name: Add a service template
POST /api/mcp-servers.description: Adds a new outside service that clients can connect assistants to.

PATCH /api/mcp-servers/{server_id}.name: Update a service template
PATCH /api/mcp-servers/{server_id}.description: Changes a service template's name, address or sign-in details.

DELETE /api/mcp-servers/{server_id}.name: Remove a service template
DELETE /api/mcp-servers/{server_id}.description: Hides a service template from the catalog, or deletes it outright when forced.

POST /api/mcp-servers/discover.name: Look up a service's sign-in
POST /api/mcp-servers/discover.description: Checks a service address and reports how it expects people to sign in.

POST /api/mcp/gateway/capabilities/searc.name: Find an assistant tool
POST /api/mcp/gateway/capabilities/searc.description: Searches the assistants and tools an AI client may use, or opens one exact entry.

GET /api/mcp/gateway/executions/{executi.name: Assistant task status
GET /api/mcp/gateway/executions/{executi.description: Shows how a task an AI assistant started is going, with the start of its results.

POST /api/mcp/gateway/agents/{agent_id}/.name: Run a tool for an assistant
POST /api/mcp/gateway/agents/{agent_id}/.description: Checks the request and then runs one approved tool on the AI assistant's behalf.

GET /api/mcp/run.name: Assistant install guide
GET /api/mcp/run.description: Explains how to add this platform to an AI assistant, with the settings to copy.

GET /api/mcp/run/plugin.name: Download assistant add-on
GET /api/mcp/run/plugin.description: Downloads the matching add-on package so an AI assistant can talk to this platform.

GET /api/mcp/status.name: Assistant connection status
GET /api/mcp/status.description: Reports whether the assistant connection is on and which tools the signed-in person can use.

GET /api/mcp/config.name: Assistant access settings
GET /api/mcp/config.description: Shows whether outside AI assistants are allowed in, and within what limits.

PUT /api/mcp/config.name: Change assistant access
PUT /api/mcp/config.description: Turns outside AI assistant access on or off and sets its limits.

DELETE /api/mcp/config.name: Reset assistant access
DELETE /api/mcp/config.description: Removes custom assistant access settings and returns to the defaults.

GET /api/mcp/tools.name: Tools for assistants
GET /api/mcp/tools.description: Lists the tools the signed-in person may use through an AI assistant.

GET /api/admin/memory/settings.name: Platform memory settings
GET /api/admin/memory/settings.description: Shows whether saved AI memory is available across the whole platform.

PUT /api/admin/memory/settings.name: Change platform memory
PUT /api/admin/memory/settings.description: Turns platform-wide AI memory on or off for everyone.

GET /api/memory/settings.name: My memory settings
GET /api/memory/settings.description: Shows whether the signed-in person's AI memory is switched on.

PUT /api/memory/settings.name: Change my memory settings
PUT /api/memory/settings.description: Lets a person turn their own AI memory on or off.

GET /api/memory.name: My saved notes
GET /api/memory.description: Lists the notes an AI assistant has saved for the signed-in person.

POST /api/memory.name: Save a memory
POST /api/memory.description: Stores a note the assistant can recall in later conversations.

POST /api/memory/search.name: Search my memories
POST /api/memory/search.description: Finds saved notes matching a phrase so an assistant can bring back earlier context.

DELETE /api/memory/{memory_id}.name: Forget a memory
DELETE /api/memory/{memory_id}.description: Deletes one saved note for good.

GET /api/metrics.name: Dashboard totals
GET /api/metrics.description: Returns the headline counts and costs shown on the dashboard.

GET /api/metrics/snapshot.name: Full metrics snapshot
GET /api/metrics/snapshot.description: Gathers every dashboard figure at once for a complete picture of activity.

GET /api/metrics/executions/timeseries.name: Activity chart
GET /api/metrics/executions/timeseries.description: Returns run counts over time for the dashboard chart, limited to what the viewer may see.

GET /api/metrics/executions/daily.name: Daily activity
GET /api/metrics/executions/daily.description: Returns day-by-day run counts and outcomes for trend charts.

GET /api/metrics/organizations.name: Activity by client
GET /api/metrics/organizations.description: Breaks run activity down by client organization.

GET /api/metrics/resources.name: Memory and processor use
GET /api/metrics/resources.description: Shows how much memory and processing power the platform has used over time.

GET /api/metrics/workflows.name: Activity by automation
GET /api/metrics/workflows.description: Breaks run activity down by automation so the busiest ones stand out.

GET /auth/mfa/status.name: Two-step sign-in status
GET /auth/mfa/status.description: Shows whether the extra sign-in step is on for this person and how many recovery codes remain.

POST /auth/mfa/totp/setup.name: Start setting up codes
POST /auth/mfa/totp/setup.description: Creates a new authenticator code for the person to add to their phone app.

POST /auth/mfa/totp/verify.name: Confirm the authenticator
POST /auth/mfa/totp/verify.description: Checks the first code from the phone app and finishes turning on the extra step.

DELETE /auth/mfa.name: Turn off the extra step
DELETE /auth/mfa.description: Removes the extra sign-in step after confirming the person's password.

POST /auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate.name: Replace recovery codes
POST /auth/mfa/recovery-codes/regenerate.description: Issues a fresh set of one-time recovery codes and cancels the old ones.

GET /auth/mfa/recovery-codes/count.name: Recovery codes left
GET /auth/mfa/recovery-codes/count.description: Shows how many unused one-time recovery codes the person has left.

GET /auth/mfa/trusted-devices.name: Remembered devices
GET /auth/mfa/trusted-devices.description: Lists the devices that can skip the extra sign-in step.

DELETE /auth/mfa/trusted-devices/{device.name: Forget one device
DELETE /auth/mfa/trusted-devices/{device.description: Removes one device's ability to skip the extra sign-in step.

DELETE /auth/mfa/trusted-devices.name: Forget all devices
DELETE /auth/mfa/trusted-devices.description: Makes every device ask for the extra sign-in step again.

GET /api/model-catalog/names.name: Friendly model names
GET /api/model-catalog/names.description: Turns raw model codes into readable names for run history, usage and settings.

GET /api/notifications.name: My notifications
GET /api/notifications.description: Lists the notices waiting for the signed-in person.

GET /api/notifications/{notification_id}.name: Read one notification
GET /api/notifications/{notification_id}.description: Shows a single notice in full.

DELETE /api/notifications/{notification_.name: Dismiss a notification
DELETE /api/notifications/{notification_.description: Clears one notice from the person's list.

GET /api/notifications/locks/upload.name: Upload lock status
GET /api/notifications/locks/upload.description: Tells an administrator whether an upload is currently blocked and why.

DELETE /api/notifications/locks/upload.name: Clear a stuck upload
DELETE /api/notifications/locks/upload.description: Releases a stuck upload so people can try again.

GET /api/settings/oauth.name: Company sign-in options
GET /api/settings/oauth.description: Lists the outside sign-in providers with whether each one is set up.

PUT /api/settings/oauth/login-preference.name: Choose sign-in behaviour
PUT /api/settings/oauth/login-preference.description: Decides whether people must use company sign-in or may still use a password.

GET /api/settings/oauth/{provider}.name: One sign-in provider
GET /api/settings/oauth/{provider}.description: Shows the saved settings for one company sign-in provider.

PUT /api/settings/oauth/microsoft.name: Set up Microsoft sign-in
PUT /api/settings/oauth/microsoft.description: Saves Microsoft work-account sign-in details so staff can use their work account.

PUT /api/settings/oauth/google.name: Set up Google sign-in
PUT /api/settings/oauth/google.description: Saves Google sign-in details so people can use their Google account.

PUT /api/settings/oauth/oidc.name: Set up another provider
PUT /api/settings/oauth/oidc.description: Saves sign-in details for any other standards-based identity provider.

DELETE /api/settings/oauth/{provider}.name: Remove a sign-in provider
DELETE /api/settings/oauth/{provider}.description: Deletes a provider's sign-in settings so it can no longer be used.

POST /api/settings/oauth/{provider}/test.name: Test a sign-in provider
POST /api/settings/oauth/{provider}/test.description: Checks that a sign-in provider answers correctly before people rely on it.

GET /api/oauth/connections/{connection_n.name: Workflow sign-in details
GET /api/oauth/connections/{connection_n.description: Shows one saved service sign-in used by workflows, without revealing the password.

POST /api/oauth/connections.name: Add a workflow sign-in
POST /api/oauth/connections.description: Saves the details a workflow needs to reach an outside service.

PUT /api/oauth/connections/{connection_n.name: Update a workflow sign-in
PUT /api/oauth/connections/{connection_n.description: Changes the saved details for a service a workflow uses.

DELETE /api/oauth/connections/{connectio.name: Remove a workflow sign-in
DELETE /api/oauth/connections/{connectio.description: Deletes a saved service sign-in that workflows no longer use.

POST /api/oauth/connections/{connection_.name: Start service sign-in
POST /api/oauth/connections/{connection_.description: Sends someone to the outside service to approve access for a workflow.

POST /api/oauth/connections/{connection_.name: Cancel service sign-in
POST /api/oauth/connections/{connection_.description: Stops an approval that is in progress and puts the connection back to unused.

POST /api/oauth/connections/{connection_.name: Renew a sign-in
POST /api/oauth/connections/{connection_.description: Gets a fresh access pass before the current one runs out.

POST /api/oauth/callback/{connection_nam.name: Service approval return
POST /api/oauth/callback/{connection_nam.description: Receives the approval from the outside service and stores the resulting access pass.

GET /api/oauth/credentials/{connection_n.name: Sign-in summary
GET /api/oauth/credentials/{connection_n.description: Shows what kind of sign-in is stored and when it expires, with passwords hidden.

GET /api/oauth/refresh_job_status.name: Renewal run progress
GET /api/oauth/refresh_job_status.description: Shows how the latest round of sign-in renewals is going.

POST /api/oauth/refresh_all.name: Renew every sign-in
POST /api/oauth/refresh_all.description: Queues a background round that renews all service sign-ins at once.
